scientific_integrity: A direct all-parameter proof is given; finite exact computational corroboration is separate from the proof. No claim of independent audit or universal historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite-field synchronous graph-Laplacian dynamics for the Cartesian product of two complete graphs at odd prime characteristic only. Previously studied general linear finite-state methods and rook-graph Smith forms do not by themselves imply the stated dynamical counts. Further hidden historical overlap remains possible.
title: Odd-prime modular Laplacian dynamics on rectangular rook graphs
